manifest.title: The ball stops rising. Gravity doesn’t stop.
manifest.summary: A ball is tossed straight up on a fixed height scale. A Motion arrow shrinks, vanishes at the top and reverses, while the gravity arrow never changes.
assumptions: Gravity fixed at 9.8 m/s^2, no air resistance, up is positive.
manifest.description: A ball rises from a launch mark and falls back on a fixed height scale. The blue motion arrow shortens, disappears at the top and points down on the way back. The dashed gravity arrow always points down with the same length.

program.source: export function evaluate({inputs,time}){const u=inputs.launchSpeed,g=9.8;const T=2*u/g;const t=Math.min(Math.max(time,0),T);const ta=u/g;const v=u-g*t;const h=u*t-g*t*t/2;const hmax=5*5/(2*g);const y0=380,sc=300/hmax;const by=y0-h*sc;const x=300;const atTop=Math.abs(t-ta)<0.004;const st=atTop?'Still for an instant':(v>0?'Moving up':'Moving down');const objs=[];objs.push(...sdk.panel({x:20,y:40,w:600,h:360,title:'Tossed ball',state:st,id:'lane.toss'}));objs.push(sdk.line('guide',200,y0,400,y0,{role:'neutral'}));objs.push(sdk.text('guide.t',150,y0+4,'Launch',{role:'neutral'}));objs.push(sdk.circle('ball.toss',x,by,24,{role:'observed'}));if(!atTop)objs.push(...sdk.vector('vec.v',{x:x+40,y:by},{value:v,direction:'up'},{scale:20,label:'v',role:'input'}));objs.push(...sdk.vector('vec.a',{x:x+90,y:by},{value:-g,direction:'up'},{scale:5,label:'a',role:'warning'}));objs.push(...sdk.callout(440,by-20,[st,'Gravity pulls down'],{id:'callout.toss'}));return{frame:{width:640,height:420,objects:objs,readouts:[{id:'motionState',value:st},{id:'gravityState',value:'Gravity pulls down'}]},quantities:{launchSpeed:u,gravity:g,apexTime:ta,apexHeight:u*u/(2*g),velocity:v,height:h}};}
